topic: Ten Red Flags Before Buying a Commercial Property
caption:
Before you sign on a commercial purchase in Chester or Montgomery County, run a focused red-flag checklist. This lesson highlights ten common warning signs — from environmental issues and title problems to zoning conflicts and deferred structural repairs — that can turn a promising deal into a costly headache. Know what expenses to budget for, what to investigate, and when to walk away. Use local examples to guide inspections and conversations with inspectors, attorneys, and planners. We work with landlords, building owners, and business buyers to prioritize inspections, negotiate repairs, and structure contingencies that protect equity. If you're exploring acquisitions or managing risk locally, visit dmsellscre.com/investors and message our team for a practical checklist and tailored guidance.
